name: Flunarizine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 10 mg once daily in the evening; stop if no improvement after 3 months

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Two or more enzyme-inducing antiepileptics; mephenytoin

contraindications: Parkinson disease or other extrapyramidal disorders
monitoring: Mood; extrapyramidal signs; review at 3 and 6 months
Caution in hepatic impairment; safety over 65 years not established

sources.citation: AA Pharma Inc. (2022). Flunarizine (flunarizine hydrochloride) capsules 5 mg [Product monograph; revised February 15, 2022]. Health Canada Drug Product Database.

revision_log.change: Tiles kept gray; monitoring adds hepatic caution and >65 years not established.
